components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The next valid action in the current workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:0; border-radius:16px; background:#0c6f73; color:#fffaf0; font:600 14px/1.25 'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.025em; box-shadow:0 18px 34px -18px rgba(0,63,67,.42); transition:background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#07575b; transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 26px 44px -20px rgba(0,63,67,.48); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#0c6f73 45%,white); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quieter adjacent action that preserves hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid rgba(7,77,79,.23); border-radius:16px; background:#fffaf0; color:#123f40; font:600 14px/1.25 'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.025em; transition:background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),color 240ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:#dcecea; color:#07575b; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#0c6f73 45%,white); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Role Navigation
components.description: Three accountable Role channels with one clearly settled selection.
components.html: <nav class="ds-role-nav" aria-label="Role"><button class="ds-role ds-role-active">Student<small>Learn and complete</small></button><button class="ds-role">Faculty<small>Review and support</small></button><button class="ds-role">Administrator<small>Author and publish</small></button></nav>
components.css: .ds-role-nav { width:220px; padding:12px; display:grid; gap:4px; background:#e7f0eb; color:#58706d; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-role { padding:12px; border:0; border-radius:20px; background:transparent; color:#58706d; text-align:left; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; transition:background-color 200ms,color 200ms,box-shadow 200ms; cursor:pointer; } .ds-role small { display:block; margin-top:2px; font-size:12px; font-weight:400; opacity:.75; } .ds-role:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.65); color:#123f40; } .ds-role-active { background:#fff; color:#123f40; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(49,37,63,.08); } .ds-role:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#0c6f73 45%,white); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact language for current learning state.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:4px 12px; border-radius:9999px; background:#dcecea; color:#07575b; font:600 12px/1.25 'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A bright, readable field for operational input on warm surfaces.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-title">Activity title</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-title" value="Reflection: noticing without fixing">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:#123f40; font:600 14px/1.25 'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field { width:100%; min-height:36px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid rgba(7,77,79,.23); border-radius:14px; background:#fffdf8; color:#123f40; font:400 14px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; transition:border-color 200ms,box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-field:hover { border-color:rgba(7,77,79,.4); } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color:#2b8585; outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#0c6f73 22%,white); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Ruled Activity Row
components.description: A full-width navigation row that keeps sequence, activity, and state in one evidence line.
components.css: .ds-activity-row { width:100%; display:grid; grid-template-columns:24px 1fr auto; gap:12px; align-items:start; padding:16px 20px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(7,77,79,.15); background:#dcecea; color:#123f40; text-align:left; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 200ms; } .ds-activity-row:hover { background:#e7f0eb; } .ds-activity-row strong { display:block; font-size:14px; line-height:20px; font-weight:600; } .ds-activity-row small { display:block; margin-top:4px; color:#58706d; font-size:12px; } .ds-activity-index { color:#58706d; font:400 12px/1.25 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace; } .ds-activity-dot { width:10px; height:10px; margin-top:4px; border-radius:9999px; background:#0c6f73; } .ds-activity-row:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#0c6f73 45%,white); outline-offset:-3px; }

components.name: Work Shell
components.description: The single authoritative ivory basin containing navigation, work, and context.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-work-shell { display:grid; grid-template-columns:180px minmax(260px,1fr) 210px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:24px; background:#fffaf0; color:#123f40; box-shadow:0 20px 55px rgba(0,62,65,.11); font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-work-rail { padding:24px; background:#e7f0eb; border-right:1px solid rgba(7,77,79,.15); } .ds-work-canvas { padding:40px; } .ds-work-canvas h2 { margin:0 0 24px; font:600 36px/1.08 Fraunces,Georgia,serif; letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-work-canvas p { margin:0; color:#58706d; line-height:2; } .ds-work-bank { padding:24px; background:#edf3ed; border-left:1px solid rgba(7,77,79,.15); font-size:14px; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Progress Current
components.description: A quiet completion track with one slow moving current.
components.css: .ds-progress { width:240px; color:#123f40; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-progress-meta { display:flex; align-items:end; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:12px; } .ds-progress-meta strong { font:600 30px/1 Fraunces,Georgia,serif; } .ds-progress-meta span { color:#58706d; font-size:12px; } .ds-progress-track { height:8px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:9999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.75); } .ds-progress-current { position:relative; display:block; width:40%; height:100%; overflow:hidden; border-radius:9999px; background:#0c6f73; } .ds-progress-current::after { position:absolute; inset:0; content:''; background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,250,240,.55),transparent); transform:translateX(-100%); animation:ds-progress-flow 4.8s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-progress-flow { 65%,100% { transform:translateX(180%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-progress-current::after { animation:none; } }

narrative.overview:
The Mind Point feels like a calm body of knowledge with work moving through it in a clear, accountable current. Deep botanical teal establishes trust and direction; warm ivory holds focused work; sage surfaces form quiet banks around supporting context. The supplied TMP leaf mark and full wordmark anchor the experience in nature without turning the product into decoration.

The system is spacious, grounded, and operational. Editorial display type brings humane warmth to moments of orientation and reflection, while the sans-serif body face keeps tasks direct and legible. Fine waterline rules organize evidence and responsibility; state changes settle quickly, with a single slow shimmer reserved for progress.
keyCharacteristics: Calm botanical color with warm, paper-like working surfaces
One authoritative workspace framed by contextual banks
Editorial Fraunces headings paired with direct Plus Jakarta Sans controls
Ruled rows and tonal fields instead of generic dashboard-card grids
Quiet flowing motion that respects reduced-motion preferences
The supplied TMP leaf mark and full “The Mind Point” name as brand anchors

rules.name: The One Current Rule
rules.body: Flow Teal identifies the active path and primary commitment; keep it concentrated so the next valid action remains unmistakable.

rules.name: The Warm Work Rule
rules.body: Focused work lives on Warm Ivory or Field, while sage is reserved for navigation, context, and state.

rules.name: The Reflective Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Fraunces for meaning, orientation, and moments of contemplation; use Plus Jakarta Sans for every instruction, action, and operational fact.

rules.name: The One Basin Rule
rules.body: Compose a single authoritative work surface with rails, ruled regions, and contextual banks; do not fragment the interface into a grid of detached cards.

rules.name: The Flat Within Rule
rules.body: Keep working regions flat at rest; use tonal layering and fine rules for structure, reserving shadows for the outer shell and the active Role choice.

rules.name: The River-Stone Rule
rules.body: Larger enclosing surfaces receive the larger curve; small state markers become pills; row structure stays ruled rather than individually rounded.

dos: Do use the exact full name “The Mind Point” and the supplied TMP leaf mark or full wordmark as the visual anchor.
Do place the next valid action in Flow Teal and keep supporting actions quieter.
Do separate work, navigation, and context with tonal banks and fine waterline rules.
Do preserve generous breathing room and a clear reading measure around reflective learning content.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and provide a reduced-motion path for every moving treatment.
donts: Don't return to the generic lavender dashboard palette or detached dashboard-card grids.
Don't use sage as a competing primary action color; it is a contextual and state-bearing field.
Don't multiply shadows inside the shell or box every section in its own rounded container.
Don't turn the nature metaphor into decorative waves, vague copy, or ornamental clutter.
Don't abbreviate the brand name in product-facing identity text.
